about_the_game:
Wear the armor of a Sardaukar commander. These infamous warriors are almost unrivaled in the Known Universe.

Purchasing this DLC unlocks the crafting schematic for the item.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features depictions of violence, blood, and imagery that some may find disturbing.
